name: Roz Havel
bio: Two simulator hours and a signature. Havel is cheap, keen, and learning faster than anyone wants to admit.

personality.label: Eager newcomer
personality.description: Repeats the checklist to steady her nerves. Takes advice seriously and celebrates small successes.

move: Route checked. Feet moving. Got it.
attack: Guns ready. I can do this.
guard: Holding this position. Watching both sides.
hold_fire: Safety on. That is the right switch.
investigate: Going to confirm it. I will call when I know.
heavy_fire: A lot coming in! I need some help here.
Still in control. Could someone cover me while I prove it?
